job.job_description:
We're looking for AI Engineers (India) for our client: Bessemer Venture Partners!




Responsibilities:

Build and deploy LLM-powered agentic AI systems with tool use, planning, and memory
Develop real-time voice AI features speech-to-text, TTS, and voice dialog management
Design RAG pipelines and retrieval systems for enterprise knowledge bases
Deploy and manage ML workloads on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, EKS)
Integrate AI components with existing product backends and APIs
Evaluate and benchmark model performance for production readiness

Qualifications & Skills:

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively in collaborative team environments
Ability to manage multiple assignments, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced setting

(*Note: Scout is an independent candidate sourcing partner for this hiring. All applications, candidate screening, and hiring-related actions are conducted directly by the respective employer's authorised recruitment team. Relevant candidates will be contacted via email and asked to attempt an assessment.)




Roles and openings are subject to change. The client reserves the right to modify, reassign, or withdraw any role, requirements, number of positions, or timelines at any time during the hiring process. Submission of an application does not guarantee assignment to a particular role or an offer of employment. All hires are contingent on standard pre-employment screening and eligibility verification.
